entries.en: Hey, choom, it's about you – "In view of the recent incident during which Militech security employees..."
entries.ro: Hei, choom, e despre tine – „Având în vedere incidentul recent în care angajații de securitate Militech...”

entries.en: "brutally maimed an NCPD officer, Night City police is requesting Militech's assistance in finding the individuals responsible..."
entries.ro: „a mutilat brutal un ofițer NCPD, poliția din Night City solicită asistența Militech pentru găsirea persoanelor responsabile...”

entries.en: Messed him up pretty bad. What he even do to you?
entries.ro: L-ai făcut praf de tot. Ce ți-a făcut, de fapt?
